purpose: Declarative specification registry. The current primary analysis is recorded in current_primary_analysis; older LOS fields are retained as design history. Null means undecided, never an automatic default.

treatment.residential: long-term versus short-term residential service setting
treatment.outpatient: intensive versus non-intensive outpatient service setting

current_primary_analysis.secondary_sensitivity_outcome: same-substance frequency reduction among episodes with an observed comparable discharge frequency
current_primary_analysis.estimand: effect in the overlap-weighted population represented by each approved service-setting sample
current_primary_analysis.stage2_selection_status: retrospective and exploratory because Stage 1 results were inspected before evidence-selection rules were frozen

approved_state_scope.residential: 18 represented jurisdictions in approved state-year cells

limits: Observed service setting is not randomized; residual confounding and selection remain possible.
Recorded completion may differ across state reporting systems and is not a clinical recovery endpoint.
The unavailable 2023 state crosswalk prevents full state-specific coding harmonization.
Frequency reduction remains secondary because comparable discharge frequency is not observed for every eligible episode.

design.year_definition: DISYR discharge cohort; not necessarily admission year

frequency_outcome.matching: same admission substance across discharge slots
frequency_outcome.multiple_matches: fail for review; no resolution rule approved
frequency_outcome.baseline_no_use_handling: Separate sustained-abstinence outcome among FREQ1=1; exclude from frequency-reduction population

missing_outcome_handling.audit_population: retain all eligible baseline-group episodes including unobserved outcomes
missing_outcome_handling.unknown_outcomes: remain unclassified; no automatic outcome imputation or zero filling
missing_outcome_handling.observation_weighting: candidate sensitivity method; not selected or fitted
missing_outcome_handling.approval: User agreed to the observed-outcome reference plus explicit missing-outcome sensitivity strategy.

frequency_outcome.approval: User explicitly agreed to identity matching, primary-slot sensitivity, and unmatched remaining unclassified.

outcome_definitions.sensitivity: Apply the same baseline-population definitions to the primary-slot comparison

estimand.primary: average treatment effect in all eligible episodes of the approved reporting population
estimand.overlap_focused_analysis: prespecified sensitivity; exact population and weighting rule pending
estimand.support_requirement: Assess overlap before claiming a reliable full-population estimate; report inadequate support explicitly rather than silently changing the target.
limitations: Target approval does not establish causal identification or resolve LOS/completion timing.
Not a national all-state population; approved reporting restrictions remain.
estimand.approval: User agreed to full eligible reporting-population target and overlap-focused sensitivity.

analysis_designs.negative: same or more use than admission
analysis_designs.operationalization: Use same-substance matching within the baseline-user population.
analysis_designs.baseline_nonusers: Separate sustained-abstinence analysis for baseline nonusers.

splits.approval: User approved 70/20/10, seed 42, and all eligible 2023 validation data by default on September 10, 2026. Final assignment generation and validation pending.
splits.stratification_approval: User explicitly agreed to setting crossed with both LOS indicators and completion, retaining all known imputation-development IDs in training.

adjustment.category_encoding: categorical; numerical source codes are not continuous measurements
adjustment.conditional_encoding: Applicability-aware imputation rules approved; exact implementation and conflict resolution pending. Preserve observed status for auditing.

heterogeneity_roles.SERVICES: X in pooled-setting analyses; omit constant in single-setting analysis

detcrim_decision.primary: Retain PSOURCE; omit DETCRIM. Preserve source DETCRIM for audit and sensitivity.
detcrim_decision.sensitivity: Compare with and without DETCRIM on identical episodes within an explicitly defined reporting-state population; report population change separately.

alternative_specifications.sample_comparison: same sample where feasible; report expansion separately
same sample with and without PRIMPAY

alternative_specifications.sample_rule: complete primary information with conditional applicability respected; not primary sample

reporting_screen.methuse_handling: separate applicability and coverage assessment; retain adjustment role

whole_state_rule.exclude_if: any required nonconditional primary adjustment variable has zero observed values within the eligible four-setting state population

temporal_state_membership_rule.rule: Freeze retained 2022 state membership for main 2023 temporal validation
temporal_state_membership_rule.audit: Check 2023 reporting and document new gaps; no automatic additional exclusions
temporal_state_membership_rule.matched_2022_evaluation: Restrict eventual 2022 held-out evaluation to represented main-validation states; preserve development membership

multiple_imputation_evaluation.scope: scattered missing covariate values within reporting groups
multiple_imputation_evaluation.implementation: Python notebook with R mice helper; user-approved
multiple_imputation_evaluation.pilot_population: Expanded 2022 pilot: 2000 episodes each in New York, Louisiana and Georgia, setting 7; observed AGE/GENDER/SUB1
multiple_imputation_evaluation.note: Does not authorize blanket imputation, final adoption, or use of 2023 data for development.

pooled_evaluation.scope: Within approved reporting-state population; state and setting predictors; whole-state gaps remain excluded

inferential_information_principle.rationale: Preserve covariate-exposure-outcome relationships for effect estimation; distinguish this objective from baseline reconstruction.
inferential_information_principle.heldout_predictive_inputs: Do not reconstruct predictive evaluation inputs using held-out outcomes.
inferential_information_principle.temporal_development: Do not use 2023 outcomes to develop or select the method.
inferential_information_principle.genuinely_missing_outcomes: Remain unclassified under the approved outcome strategy.
inferential_information_principle.cross_fitting_integration: Must be specified and validated before production use; no integration selected.
inferential_information_principle.reference_scope: MI with IPTW in studied MAR settings; not validation of the complete AIPW or causal-forest workflow.
inferential_information_principle.approval: User explicitly agreed to the principle and stated information boundaries.

required_before_production: Expand beyond the nine-variable reconstruction pilot to agreed analytical variables.
Implement and validate conditional-variable and substance-slot rules.
Specify and validate integration with AIPW, cross-fitting, and uncertainty.
Inspect sparse-category support and report failures; no silent algorithm fallback.
candidate_roles.approval: User agreed to categorical regression as primary candidate and CART as alternative-method sensitivity.

conditional_detail_imputation.applicable_missing_detail: Impute substantive detail using applicable records.
conditional_detail_imputation.inapplicable: Retain structural not applicable; do not impute a substantive detail.
conditional_detail_imputation.parent_and_detail_missing: Impute parent first; determine applicability within each completed dataset before handling detail.
conditional_detail_imputation.observed_detail_conflicting_or_parent_mi: Flag for separate review; do not silently overwrite source fields or infer the parent.
conditional_detail_imputation.explicit_unknown_detail_comparison: Candidate sensitivity; does not replace primary applicability-aware procedure.
required_checks: no substantive fill for structural non-applicability
conditional_detail_imputation.approval: User agreed to the four-case procedure; conflicting records require separate review.

additional_substance_count_imputation.lower_bound: number of observed additional slots containing a substance
additional_substance_count_imputation.upper_bound: lower bound plus number of unknown additional slots
additional_substance_count_imputation.allowed_values: integers from lower bound through upper bound, inclusive, within 0..2
additional_substance_count_imputation.both_slots_known: Calculate exact count; do not impute or alter it.
additional_substance_count_imputation.source_preservation: Keep original slots; do not invent substance identities or overwrite unknown slots.
additional_substance_count_imputation.model_constraint: Assign probability only to feasible totals; model and sparse-support handling still require validation.
additional_substance_count_imputation.outcomes: No change to discharge-substance matching; missing outcomes remain unclassified.
additional_substance_count_imputation.approval: User agreed to constrained total-count imputation for the primary adjustment model.

pooled_inferential_candidate.whole_state_reporting_exclusions: Preserve approved exclusions; pooling does not authorize imputation of excluded state-level reporting gaps.
diagnostics: imputed distributions by state and setting
pooled_inferential_candidate.unsupported_or_unstable: Flag for review; no silent constant fill or automatic new exclusions.
pooled_inferential_candidate.assumption: Some relationships are borrowed across groups; state indicators do not remove this assumption.
pooled_inferential_candidate.approval: User agreed to extend pooling from reconstruction evaluation to the candidate final imputation model, subject to validation.

adaptive_imputation_count.development: Use a small number for implementation/debugging; exact computational settings recorded per run.
adaptive_imputation_count.start_condition: Expanded model passes development checks; benchmark runtime before full-data execution.
adaptive_imputation_count.increase_if: Estimates or standard errors remain too sensitive to imputation randomness under a documented precision criterion.

precision_criterion.quantity: Monte Carlo standard error of primary effect estimate
precision_criterion.calculation: Must match final inference procedure; formula and implementation pending.
precision_criterion.failure_action: Increase imputations and report additional runtime; no significance-based stopping.

adaptive_imputation_count.iterations: Separate tuning parameter; twenty imputations does not specify twenty iterations.
adaptive_imputation_count.approval: User agreed to adaptive counts starting at twenty after development validation.
adaptive_imputation_count.precision_approval: User agreed to Monte Carlo error no larger than ten percent of the primary effect standard error, with separate stability and chain checks.

replication.note: Prepared _rep reproduces selection with corrected feature encoding.

los30_recovery.reason: Prioritize revised analysis; original-specification threshold comparison remains incomplete.

unresolved: integration of approved derived features into final analytical datasets

nuisance_models.selection_data: permitted development data, respecting cross-fitting and protected evaluation partitions
nuisance_models.causal_forest_roles: Retain separately approved replication and heterogeneity roles.
nuisance_models.approval: User agreed to both supporting-model candidates and the proposed selection principle.

primary_average_effect.fold_approval: User explicitly agreed to five-fold cross-fitting, separate from the 70/20/10 development partitions.

heterogeneity.validation: separate validation required; exact procedure pending

estimation.approval: User explicitly agreed to AIPW with cross-fitting for the revised average effect, causal forests for replication and heterogeneity.
limits: Does not resolve LOS/completion timing, unmeasured confounding, or poor overlap.
Does not select final missing-data handling or inference.

uncertainty_direction.primary_candidate: state-cluster-aware uncertainty for primary AIPW result
required_review: retained cluster count and size distribution
limits: State predictors do not substitute for clustered inference.
Dependence across states remains an assumption requiring consideration.
Does not correct confounding or LOS/completion timing.
uncertainty_direction.approval: User agreed to this direction; no exact variance formula or bootstrap adopted.

episode_fold_development.approval: User agreed to develop and validate episode-fold, state-adjusted route first; clustered inference remains provisional.
limitations: Complete-input component only; MI integration not implemented.
Not cluster-separated DML; clustered standard errors are not validated by these tests.

implementation_progress.crossfit_component: implemented; fixed-fold alignment and scoring-label perturbation tests passed

sensitivity_analysis_plan.scope: Six sensitivity families; main analyses and diagnostics classified separately

coordination_update.scope: Same >30-day treatment, two DVs; tests and sensitivities cover both; methodological improvements permitted.
coordination_update.methodological_discretion: Do not seek repeated permission for routine defensible implementation improvements; document rationale and unresolved identification limits.
coordination_update.does_not_establish: No statistical method or completed result is approved or validated merely by this scope decision.

components: Outcome-observation selection assessment for each DV
endogeneity_assessment.limitations: No omnibus test proves absence of endogeneity. Realized LOS/outcome joint determination remains; no unsupported IV or reverse-causality test.
